A listening & identification exercise on family vocabulary — taught by Karla, in English.

La famille

You can replay the track as many times as you like while you work through the exercise below.
Instructions

Listen, then spot the family members

« Florian montre son album de photos à son amie Coralie. Écoutez Florian et repérez sur la photo les personnes citées. »

Florian is showing his photo album to his friend Coralie. Listen to Florian and identify in the photo the people he mentions.

La photo

As you listen, try to point to (or picture) each person Florian names.

Exercice 1

Which family members does Florian mention?

Listen carefully, then check every family member you hear Florian name. Some terms below are decoys he never mentions — listen closely!

Score : 0/10
Exercice 2

Classe les membres de la famille dans l’ordre

« Classe les membres de la famille dans l’ordre dans lequel ils sont mentionnés. »

Rank the family members in the order Florian mentions them. Two of them are mentioned together, in the very same breath — so they share the same rank.

Score : 0/10
